TC-11/S12.title: Double tap on Generate, and leaving the chart while the note and the timeline are still being written
TC-11/S12.detail: PW on the local stack, variants a (second charts with an empty course) and b (second charts seeded with a dated line and a reason); generateNote held 3 s and refreshCourseAndBackground 9 s by the socket mock, so the late writes land while the second chart is open. Passed in both variants: the double tap sent one generateNote call and left H1 with one note and exactly one card dated today, no 'Encounter done'; Regenerate on H1 then straight to H2, and Generate on R1 then straight to R2: H2 and R2 never showed H1/R1's name or a line dated today, before or after the first chart's writes landed, and their stored reason and course stayed byte-equal to the seed and they gained no note, encounter text, carry-forward (Hospital) or status change (no wrong-patient write); R1 got its note and one 'Visit 1 – Oct 15' line, no 'Encounter done'. Failed (T2: the entry comes from the finished note): after Regenerate-and-leave, H1's timeline line is still the FIRST note's entry ('Less short of breath…'), while the note and tomorrow's carry-forward are the regenerated one ('Breathing easier…'); a control run that stays on the chart gets the regenerated entry. The Hospital twin of the Nursing Home step (Generate Note & Finish, then at once back to the list and into another patient) loses today's entry completely: the stored course goes '(none)' -> 'Oct 15: Encounter done' -> '' and the reopened chart shows no Course Timeline at all, although the note exists and the 'Carried forward' card shows the entry (reproduced 2/2; the Regenerate case 4/4 across runs). Nursing Home is not affected.
TC-11/S12.productIssue: Hospital: a physician who taps Generate Note & Finish (or Regenerate Note) and leaves the chart before the timeline refresh comes back (back to the list, next patient - a few seconds) gets a wrong Course Timeline: after a first Generate today's line is erased and the completed note has no timeline entry at all; after a Regenerate the line keeps the previous note's entry while the carry-forward shows the new one. Staying on the chart works. Likely cause (code read): useNoteGeneration.ts refreshCourse merges over getLatestPatient(), a ref in routes/rounding/Patient.tsx that stops updating once the chart unmounts, and its write guard courseUnchangedSince(sum.course, doneCourse) has only the post-flip value as a baseline, so the stale pre-Generate course counts as 'a newer human edit' and is written back (the Nursing Home tab also accepts its pre-Generate value: courseUnchangedSince(current, before, doneCourse)).
